newsitem.title: USA: D&P places Valcor on watch for possible downgrade.
newsitem.headline: D&P places Valcor on watch for possible downgrade.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Thursday it has placed the senior notes of Valcor Inc on rating watch--down.
Valcor's senior notes are currently rated double-B-minus. About $69 million of debt is affected by the rating action.

Valcor is currently seeking the consent of its noteholders to eliminate the notes' restrictive financial covenants. These covenants restrict, among other things, the company's ability to pay dividends, incur debt, and invest in unrelated businesses. Valcor has also offered to purchase all of the outstanding notes.

Valcor's parent company, Valhi Inc, has senior debt (LYONs) rated single-B-plus. The higher rating of Valcor is largely based on the covenant protection afforded by the notes. Therefore, if the covenant amendments are approved, the remaining notes will be downgraded to the level of the parent's rating of single-B-plus, D&P said in a news release.
